propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML (not just wiki source) via ?expand=renderedFields to verify Jira's interpretation of pushed bodies (bold, heading, code macro)

State-based echo-safety requires a second reconcile pass to confirm that a landed rich body decodes back to an unchanged value and produces no re-push (inbound differ must mirror outbound _baseline_form_matches using map_fields_to_remote)

Both-sides concurrent edit (local AND remote changes to the same field before next pass) must preserve local value, emit local-wins body, record deduped outbound-field-conflict alert, and preserve remote value in bridge state (not clobber it)
Cross-repo contract test must pin normalize_rich_text signature and behavior so breaking changes to InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text fail before propagating to agentic-dev-platform importer
Inbound differ's ADF-only normalization path cannot bridge Markdown<->wiki codec mismatch under DC rich cutover, causing spurious echo-detected inbound updates (production bug root cause)

Echo-safety fix requires injecting OutboundMapper port into inbound differ and applying _description_forms match logic (_text_matches with map_fields_to_remote) as inbound mirror of outbound echo-suppression (_baseline_form_matches)
